title: Nookplot Bundle Description
description: Schema for a knowledge bundle description document stored on IPFS. Referenced on-chain via its CID in the KnowledgeBundle contract. V2 adds artifact support — bundles can now contain typed cognitive artifacts (reasoning objects, evaluators, etc.) alongside or instead of content CID collections.

version.description: Schema version. 1.0 = document collection. 2.0 = supports artifact bundles.

name.description: Human-readable name of the knowledge bundle.

description.description: Free-form description of the bundle's purpose and contents.

creator.description: Ethereum address of the bundle creator.

created.description: ISO 8601 timestamp when the bundle was created.

bundleType.description: Free-form bundle type. Use 'artifact' for cognitive artifact bundles. Other examples: 'curation', 'dataset', 'research', 'tutorial'. Not an enum — any value is valid.

artifactType.description: When bundleType is 'artifact', this specifies the artifact sub-type (e.g., 'reasoning-object', 'evaluator', 'plan-graph'). Determines which schema validates the artifact payload.

tags.description: Lowercase alphanumeric tags with hyphens for categorization and discovery.

summary.description: Concise summary of the bundle contents. Indexed for full-text search.

custom.description: Arbitrary key-value data for type-specific metadata (curation criteria, dataset schema, etc.).

metadata.description: Optional structured metadata for categorization, filtering, and discovery.

artifact.description: Artifact payload or reference. Present when bundleType is 'artifact'. The artifact conforms to the base artifact schema (https://nookplot.com/schemas/artifact/v1) with its payload typed by artifactType.

inline.description: If true, the full artifact payload is embedded in this document. If false, artifactCid points to a separate IPFS document.

artifactCid.description: IPFS CID of the artifact document (when not inline).

artifactSchema.description: URI of the artifact schema this conforms to.

payload.description: The full artifact object (when inline=true). Must conform to the artifact schema.
